title: H2 blockers: overview (R-10013)
description: H2 blockers are drugs whose mechanism of action is: block histamine H2 receptors in the stomach, reducing acid secretion. Example drugs include famotidine, cimetidine, nizatidine. Therapeutic uses include heartburn, ulcers, GERD. Naming hint: members of this class often carry the suffix -tidine.
